name: The Hayseed Knight
source:
The Hayseed Knight is an indie visual novel created by a single person that follows the adventures of Ader, the one eyed deer, while he desperately tries to stay on track to fulfill his dream: becoming a knight. 

On a meta sense, the player is The Narrator, a character hellbent on finding out what truly happened to Ader and his friends, who are little more than legendary characters at this point.

[From [url=https://sandramj.itch.io/the-hayseed-knight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《草籽骑士》是一部由一个人创作的独立视觉小说，讲述了独眼鹿阿德的冒险故事，同时他拼命地试图保持正轨以实现他的梦想：成为一名骑士。

从元意义上来说，玩家是叙述者，这个角色一心想找出阿德和他的朋友们到底发生了什么，而他们在这一点上只不过是传奇人物。

[来自[url=https://sandramj.itch.io/the-hayseed-knight]Itch.io[/url]]
